name: jarl
description: Skill that turns your coding agent into the director of a feature branch: an issue loop (kept out of git by default, committed when you ask) where everything seen becomes an issue, a worker per issue works in its own worktree, evidence decides what merges, and the loop leaves no trace on main.

args: const f=process.argv[1];if(!require("fs").existsSync(f)){console.error("jarl: "+f+" is not reachable from this environment (a host path inside a container?), so jarl did not run");process.exit(0)}const r=require("child_process").spawnSync(process.execPath,process.argv.slice(1),{stdio:"inherit"});process.exit(r.status===null?1:r.status)
